[[Wajjun Bazaar]] | collector = y | henchman = y | merchant = y | storage = y | pic1 = [[Image:The Marketplace world map.jpg|196px]] | pic1-text = On the world map | pic2 = [[Image:The Marketplace inside.jpg|196px]] | pic2-text = A view from inside | pic3 = [[Image:Kaineng to Marketplace map.jpg|196px]] | pic3-text = From Kaineng Center to the Marketplace }} {{Quotation|game|A favorite destination for locals and foreign visitors alike, this bustling marketplace is the place to find locally made trinkets, fresh products and fish, and traditional Canthan delicacies such as pickled vermin tongue.}} [[The Marketplace]] is a bustling and popular trading place for locals and foreigners alike. The location of being close to [[Kaineng City]]'s center and being next to [[Kaineng Docks]] probably contributed much to its popularity. ==Getting there== [[Factions]] characters will have to accept the [[primary quest]] [[A Master's Burden]] to get from [[Shing Jea Island]] to [[Kaineng Docks]], which is just outside the Marketplace. Characters from other [[campaign]]s will have to travel south from [[Kaineng Center]] through [[Bukdek Byway]]. Non-Factions characters will need to pass through here and into Kaineng Docks if they want to reach Shing Jea Island. ==Exits== *[[Bukdek Byway]] (northeast) *[[Kaineng Docks]] (northwest) *[[Wajjun Bazaar]] (southwest) ==Quests available== *[[Guardsman Makuruyo]] **[[Deactivating P.O.X.]] ==NPCs== ===Allies=== *{{x}} 10 [[Attendant Nashu]] ([[collector]] for 5 [[Putrid Cyst]]s) *{{x}} 20 [[Hasung]] ([[merchant]]) *{{x}} 15 [[Xunlai Agent]] ([[storage upgrades]]) *{{x}} 24 [[Xunlai Chest]] ([[storage]]) *{{w}} 20 [[Guardsman Makuruyo]] ([[mission briefing]]) ====Henchmen==== :''(all level 20)'' *{{w}} [[Talon Silverwing]] (Fighter) *{{r}} [[Zho]] (Archer) *{{mo}} [[Sister Tai]] (Healer) *{{n}} [[Su]] (Grave) *{{me}} [[Lo Sha]] (Illusion) *{{e}} [[Headmaster Vhang]] (Shock) *{{e}} [[Kai Ying]] (Earth) *{{a}} [[Panaku]] (Cutthroat) *{{rt}} [[Professor Gai]] (Spirit) ====Other allies==== *{{r}} 5 [[Horus]] *{{r}} 5 [[Knoxx]] *{{r}} 5 [[Odin]] *{{r}} 5 [[Riker]] ==Notes== *[[Factions]] characters who left [[Shing Jea Island]] early and arrived here before reaching at least level 18 may want to be extra careful with the foes in the surrounding areas, who are very noticeably more dangerous and lethal compared to the foes on the island. *Complete exploration of this outpost contributes approximately 0.3% to the Canthan [[Cartographer]] title. ==Trivia== *The [[Factions Preview Event]] used this outpost as the starting point for new Factions characters, with [[Brother Mhenlo]] and [[Master Togo]] offering quests that would take them outside (which actually led to [[Pongmei Valley]]). {{Towns and outposts in Kaineng City}}
